lay_text: I've had fevers for nine months, sometimes up to 40 degrees. I'm exhausted all the time, and I've lost a lot of weight.

It's been getting worse. On the steroids and the other medicines I still had a low fever and my blood counts hardly got better. Ten days after I stopped the prednisone and the cyclosporine myself, the high fevers came back.
My joints swelled up at times during this illness.
I've had asthma for four years, but I've never taken anything for it. Nothing else.
No, I don't have anything to do with animals.
No, I haven't been around anyone with a fever.
My husband is fine. Nobody in the family gets lots of infections.
I'm from Shanxi, in the north; my home town is there. I go back and forth between home and Zhongshan regularly for work.

For the lupus they gave me high-dose steroids, cyclosporine, hydroxychloroquine, tofacitinib and injections of telitacicept. I still had a low fever the whole time, and my blood counts hardly got better.
I was on prednisone 20 mg a day and cyclosporine twice a day, but I stopped them both myself ten days ago.
